title: HOW TO Machine Difficult Materials — MSC Industrial Supply Co.
summary: In this episode of MSC’s How To, explore how the right approach to machining difficult materials can improve tool life, chip control, surface finish and more.
body_markdown:
## Looking for full transcript of video?Read now


Learn how to machine difficult materials like stainless steel, Inconel and titanium with the right tooling, cutting parameters and machining strategies.


In this episode of MSC’s *How To* , host Jacob Sanchez visits the Mitsubishi Materials North American Technology Center to explore what makes difficult-to-machine materials so challenging—and how the right approach can improve tool life, chip control, surface finish and overall machining performance.


Mitsubishi Materials experts Brian Jewell, David Casey, Muykim “Kim” Ly and Devin Smith break down how material properties influence tooling selection and machining strategy. Through hands-on turning and milling demonstrations, they explore heat management, insert coatings and geometries, chip formation and evacuation, high-pressure coolant, cutter engagement and toolpath strategy.


See how these principles are applied when machining challenging materials including Inconel 718 and titanium, and learn how matching the right cutting tools and machining techniques to the application can help create a more stable, predictable and efficient process.
